tool.name: recalls_search_drug
tool.description: Returns FDA drug recall enforcement reports (recall number, product, reason, classification, status, date, firm), at most 'limit' records, newest first. Use when asked whether a drug or medicine has been recalled in the US. With no filters it returns the newest recalls. An empty list means no matching records. Do not use for food (use recalls_search_food) or consumer products (use recalls_search_consumer). Data is unvalidated and not medical advice.

product.description: Words from the product description, for example a drug name or brand. Optional.

firm.description: Name of the recalling company, for example a manufacturer. Optional.

date_from.description: Earliest report date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Optional.

date_to.description: Latest report date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return, 1 to 50.
